rows.statement: Vercel says it protects customer projects across access, application, and infrastructure security

sides.text: Vercel protects your projects across access, application, and infrastructure security.

rows.statement: Basic build machines (2 vCPU, 8 GB) are available on Pro and Enterprise

sides.text: Pro and Enterprise teams can now select Basic build machines, 2 vCPU and 8 GB, a lower-cost option for smaller apps. New projects still default to Elastic.

rows.statement: Cursor Cloud Agents can run in Vercel Sandbox

sides.text: Cursor Cloud Agents can now run in Vercel Sandbox

rows.statement: Notion runs millions of agent conversations daily on Vercel

sides.text: Notion powers millions of agent conversations daily on Vercel.

rows.statement: Vercel Connect lets agents deploy apps and transfer ownership via a claim URL into the user's own account

sides.text: Let your agent deploy apps for users, then transfer ownership with a claim URL so each deployment lands in the user's own Vercel account.

rows.statement: Pro teams get one free domain for the first year across eight eligible TLDs including .app and .dev

sides.text: The free domain with Pro offer now covers .app and .dev, bringing the eligible TLDs to eight. Every Pro team can claim one domain, free for the first year.

rows.statement: The Vercel MCP server lets agents search docs, manage projects and deployments, and query Web Analytics

sides.text: Let your agent search the docs, manage projects and deployments, and query Web Analytics through the Vercel MCP server.

rows.statement: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 is callable through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key

sides.text: Call Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.
